sections.heading: DISCUSSION
sections.text: Dry air and gusty southwest winds will keep fire danger elevated through the afternoon. A Red Flag Warning is in effect.

sections.heading: TODAY
sections.text: Sunny. Highs in the upper 70s. Minimum relative humidity 24 percent. Southwest winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts to 35 mph. Mixing height 4500 feet.

sections.heading: TONIGHT
sections.text: Clear. Lows in the lower 50s. Maximum relative humidity 70 percent. Southwest winds 10 to 15 mph.
